title: Office breakers off when unused
summary: Cut work-area circuits when the room is unused to lower daytime artificial field load from chargers, monitors, and networking gear. Described alongside Work Space.

sections.heading: Daytime field hygiene
sections.body: Home offices accumulate chargers, monitors, docks, and networking gear that stay energized for hours. Switching labeled office circuits off when the room is unused—or using a shutdown ritual with power strips—reduces chronic low-level electrical and RF-adjacent load for people optimizing nnEMF. Distance helps too: keep active electronics several feet from where you sit when you can.

sections.heading: Practical shutdown ritual
sections.body: Label desk and office circuits with help if needed. End-of-day: save work, power down or unplug what you can, flip breakers or kill the strip feeding the desk cluster. Some people run a shielded extension into a room with wall circuits off so only chosen loads are live—advanced and electrician-dependent. Skip on travel days or shared offices you do not control.

sections.heading: Pair with desk habits while working
sections.body: Breakers-off when unused is the empty-room half. While working, use Work Space options: grounding mat (verified Earth), low artificial field (phone off lap, router distance), and air-tube headphones for calls. nnEMF reduction blocks cover intentional airplane-mode hours anywhere in the day.

sections.heading: Where Dr. Jack Kruse’s teaching is specific
sections.body: Kruse’s nnEMF teaching extends beyond the bedroom: long desk days in dirty electrical environments are framed as mitochondrial load. Community gear lists emphasize distance, wired Ethernet, and killing unused circuits. Treat product absolutism as culture; treat “power down what you do not need” as ordinary engineering sense inside his stack.

sections.heading: What is solid, what is framework
sections.body: Solid ground: idle electronics still draw and radiate or couple noise; labeled shutdowns reduce continuous exposure; shared walls and apartments limit what you can cut. Framework: that office breaker habits alone reverse metabolic disease. Use as Work Space hygiene.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: If safe and appropriate, switch off unused office circuits when the room is unoccupied. Keep this as part of the daytime routine when useful, and omit it while traveling. Pair with Sleep Space for the night counterpart. Educational only—not electrical code advice.
